businesses.business: HVAC and detection and measurement equipment

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures heating, ventilation and cooling products, plus detection and measurement systems such as underground utility locators, bus fare collection, communication technologies and obstruction lighting. Sells to building owners, contractors, utilities and transit and infrastructure operators.

primary_products.value: cooling towers; boilers; electric heating and ventilation products; underground pipe and cable locators; fare collection systems

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts and repair; installation and replacement support; inspection and monitoring services

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial building owners, contractors, utilities, industrial plants, telecom operators; B2G: municipal transit agencies, public utilities, government infrastructure operators

end_markets.value: commercial construction; industrial; utilities; transportation; telecommunications

revenue_model.value: product sales: HVAC equipment, locators, detection and measurement systems; project or contract: engineered cooling towers and fare collection system projects; service fees: aftermarket parts, repair and replacement services
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds HVAC and detection equipment from purchased materials and components, sold to contractors, utilities and operators

geography_served.value: global: North America primarily, plus Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East and South Africa

specialization.value: related lines: HVAC segment and Detection & Measurement segment, both engineered infrastructure products

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent sales representatives, wholesalers and distributors for HVAC and locators; direct sales: engineered projects sold to utilities, transit agencies and large customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, energy efficiency and emissions standards, plus aviation lighting and telecom rules

notes: Segment details are from general knowledge and may have changed with recent acquisitions or divestitures.
